annotations.title: List or claim ADU plans on A-du

description: For an architect, designer, general contractor or builder who wants homeowners to find their ADU plans on A-du Build. Without plan_id it returns the link to list a new plan set. With the plan_id of a plan a city or county published that the person drew, it returns the link that opens the claim for that plan, so they manage its price, permitting service and buyer requests; plans an agency offers for free cannot be claimed, and the tool says so. Listing is free and it needs no account to call: the person signs in, verifies identity and publishes in the browser, which an assistant cannot do for them. On A-du Build, the customer pays only the plan or permitting price, with no A-du service fee on top. A-du's 3% platform service fee on plan purchases and permitting services is deducted from the vendor's payout. The flat-fee permitting service that Chris Koss, AIA, a California-licensed architect who owns A-du, provides personally under a separate written agreement with the homeowner carries no A-du fee (A-du is not a party to that agreement and provides only the technology platform, payment orchestration and permit tracking for it), and neither do government permit fee reimbursements; free plans stay free. A credit card, when offered, adds the 2.99% surcharge on the amount paid, paid by the customer; debit and prepaid cards are not accepted. Example: {"plan_id": "ac178fff-d9ac-47d9-a28c-01ce5de46027"}.

plan_id.description: Only to claim an existing plan: its A-du id, from search_plans or a a-du.homes/build/design/<id> URL.
